chore(env): update example environment variables for Waffo pricing plans

This commit adds new environment variable entries for Waffo pricing plans in the .env.local.example file, including monthly, yearly, and lifetime IDs. This update ensures that developers have the latest configuration options available for integration with the Waffo billing gateway.

commits.message_full:
chore(skills): remove deprecated skills and update skill paths

This commit deletes several outdated skills, including "better-auth-best-practices," "better-auth-security-best-practices," "billing-sdk," and "brainstorming." The skills-lock.json file has been updated to reflect these removals and to ensure the remaining skills have accurate paths and computed hashes. This cleanup enhances maintainability and reduces clutter in the skills repository.

commits.message: refactor(layout): consolidate SaaS shell structure and enhance app home overview
commits.message_full:
refactor(layout): consolidate SaaS shell structure and enhance app home overview

This update refines the layout for the signed-in SaaS application by consolidating the shell structure into a single layout component. The `layoutType` configuration has been removed, and the app now utilizes a unified `AppLayout`. Additionally, the app home overview has been introduced, providing users with a snapshot of their account status, including billing and security features. Various components have been added or modified to support this new structure, improving the overall user experience and maintainability.

commits.message_full:
test(e2e): serve a production build via Playwright webServer + retries

The e2e suite previously required a hand-started `next dev --turbo`
server. Under sustained load that dev server's Turbopack worker pool
crashes (EPIPE / "Jest worker exceeding retry limit"), returning 500s on
/api/** that surfaced as flaky auth failures (e.g. change-password and
reset-password re-login).

Add a Playwright webServer that builds and serves a compiled production
app (`pnpm build && pnpm start`), which has no dev-worker pool and is both
stable and much faster. Locally an already-running server is reused; CI
builds fresh. Add retries (CI 2 / local 1) as a flaky safety net.

`next start` is unsupported with `output: standalone`, so gate the
standalone output behind E2E_DISABLE_STANDALONE, which the webServer sets
alongside DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRATEGY=database_url_first.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(settings): drop nested <main>; harden settings e2e asserts

The settings layout rendered a <main> inside the app shell's <main>
(invalid nested landmark). Use a plain container so there is a single
<main> per page.

During streaming SSR a hidden buffer copy of a settings page can briefly
coexist with the rendered one, so getByTestId(...).toBeVisible() hit a
Playwright strict-mode violation (2 matches). Scope the settings-page
assertions to the visible instance, and assert the change-password
success via the locale-independent sonner success toast instead of a
hardcoded English string.
